root_cause.text: The GET_INSTANCE_ID macro in the hp-bioscfg driver uses an off-by-one loop condition (<= instead of <) that can access beyond array bounds, and lacks a NULL check on `attr_name_kobj` before dereferencing its `name` member, leading to a null pointer dereference and kernel panic when reading sysfs attributes.
root_cause.evidence: The patch changes the loop condition from `i <= instances_count` to `i < instances_count` and adds a NULL check: `if (bioscfg_drv.type##_data[i].attr_name_kobj && !strcmp(kobj->name, ...))`. The commit message explicitly states "Off-by-one error" and "Missing NULL check", and the panic trace shows a null-ptr-deref in `min_length_show`.
